dropped_latest_records.summary: Static benchmarks fail to capture domain drift in enterprise knowledge bases. We establish a synthetic test generator that auto-creates paired evaluation sets whenever new corpora are ingested.

dropped_latest_records.summary: We define freshness service-level agreements (SLAs) for temporal document ingestion. By tracking document age and update cadence, our orchestrator dynamically prioritizes recrawling high-churn technical corpora.

dropped_latest_records.title: Synthetic Corruption Testing: Stress-Testing Vector Search Robustness
dropped_latest_records.summary: We introduce an automated fuzzing suite that corrupts text chunks by injecting noise, truncating titles, and blanking summaries. Experiments reveal critical failure thresholds for dense embedding retrieval.
